name: 86 Chaos 16.0.36 Release Gate Error Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.36 Release Gate Error Fix
notes: Fixes the confirmed schedule identity crash, controlled unauthenticated API responses, automatic crash reporting, service-worker activation, and push receipt evidence without visual changes.
releaseNotes: Recurring reminders now retain one occurrence through retries and advance to a fresh occurrence only after successful delivery.
Personal reminder edits, sharing, and participant actions are validated by authenticated server endpoints and same-workspace membership checks.
Shared Firestore listener caching is isolated by Firebase project, workspace, and authenticated viewer, with targeted cache cleanup.
Schedule, availability, time-off, and trade-board queries use separate canonical identities and deployed query indexes.
System Administrator orphan-shift cleanup now uses protected server-side dry-run records, revalidation, bounded deletion, and partial-result reporting.
Native backup verification uses exact database resources, paginated Admin API results, explicit READY state, normalized retention, and sanitized errors.
Server tests use Node test runner behavior assertions for reminder recurrence, push-device eligibility, Python hash stability, and backup parsing.
Visual design, layouts, spacing, colors, and styles are unchanged.
